pipelines.name: common

steps.name: Install operator
steps.run:
kubectl create ns camel
# the extra configuration is required to run the container registry with secret
kubectl create configmap camel-k-operator-configmap-configuration \
  --from-literal=ENABLE_DEV_REGISTRY_SECRET="true" \
  --from-literal=MAVEN_REPOSITORIES_ALLOWED="https://maven.repository.redhat.com/ga@id=redhat" \
  -n camel
# make the test aware that each Integration requires a pull secret
E2E_TEST_REGISTRY_SECRET_COPY=true
echo "E2E_TEST_REGISTRY_SECRET_COPY=$E2E_TEST_REGISTRY_SECRET_COPY" >> $GITHUB_ENV
echo "Setting E2E_TEST_REGISTRY_SECRET_COPY=true in order to automate the copy of the pull secret and the setting in each test"

kubectl apply -k install/overlays/all-namespaces/ --server-side --force-conflicts
kubectl wait --for=condition=available deployment/camel-k-operator -n camel --timeout=60s
# Install Apache Kamelets catalog
mvn -q dependency:copy -Dartifact=org.apache.camel.kamelets:camel-kamelets:4.22.0:jar -Dmdep.useBaseVersion=true -DoutputDirectory=/tmp
unzip /tmp/camel-kamelets-4.22.0.jar -d /tmp && kubectl apply -f /tmp/kamelets -n camel

steps.name: Run test
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# Cleanup function to stop tunnel
cleanup() {
  echo "** Stopping Minikube tunnel"
  if [[ -n "${TUNNEL_PID-}" ]]; then
    kill "$TUNNEL_PID" || true
  fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT

echo "** Starting Minikube tunnel (requires sudo)"
minikube tunnel &
TUNNEL_PID=$!

DO_TEST_PREBUILD=false GOTESTFMT="-json 2>&1 | gotestfmt" make test-gateway

pipelines.name: Nightly check against ARM64 architecture and JDK21

steps.name: Install operator
steps.run:
THIS_VERSION="$(make get-version)"
VERSION="$(make get-version | sed s/-SNAPSHOT//)-nightly"
IMAGE="testcamelk/camel-k:$VERSION"
echo "Checking that $IMAGE includes a linux/arm64 image..."
if ! docker buildx imagetools inspect --raw "$IMAGE" |
  jq -e '.manifests[] | select(.platform.os == "linux" and .platform.architecture == "arm64")' >/dev/null; then
  echo "::error::Operator image $IMAGE does not contain a linux/arm64 manifest."
  exit 1
fi
sed -i "s#apache/camel-k:$THIS_VERSION#testcamelk/camel-k:$VERSION#g" install/base/config/manager/operator-deployment.yaml
kubectl create ns camel
kubectl create configmap camel-k-operator-configmap-configuration \
  --from-literal=MAVEN_REPOSITORIES_ALLOWED="https://maven.repository.redhat.com/ga@id=redhat" \
  -n camel
kubectl apply -k install/overlays/all-namespaces/ --server-side --force-conflicts
if ! kubectl wait --for=condition=available deployment/camel-k-operator -n camel --timeout=60s; then
  echo "::group::Operator deployment diagnostics"
  kubectl get pods -n camel -o wide || true
  kubectl describe deployment/camel-k-operator -n camel || true
  kubectl get events -n camel --sort-by=.lastTimestamp || true
  echo "::endgroup::"
  exit 1
fi
# Install Apache Kamelets catalog
mvn -q dependency:copy -Dartifact=org.apache.camel.kamelets:camel-kamelets:4.18.1:jar -Dmdep.useBaseVersion=true -DoutputDirectory=/tmp
unzip /tmp/camel-kamelets-4.18.1.jar -d /tmp && kubectl apply -f /tmp/kamelets -n camel
